title: arc themes (canon/themes.yaml)
description: What the book is about, given identity so it can be checked (conventions §15). A theme is a collection entry rather than an entity: it participates in no event and sits at no place. `carriers` are the canon that embodies it — vision.md's own rule, that a theme without a carrier is a wish. `motifs` are the words the author already writes in scene contracts, which is how appearances on the page are computed rather than declared.

carriers.description: Canon ids that embody this theme — entities, events, relationships, chapters.

motifs.description: The words this theme goes by in scene contracts. Matched case-insensitively so the author writes prose, not ids.
